description: Use this to reuse an arrangement on a second stream instead of rebuilding it: copies one playlist's contents into another playlist of the same kind. The target must be EMPTY — this never merges or overwrites. The target stream picks the contents up on its next start; if it is already live, swap_live_playlist puts them on the air.

targetPlaylistId.description: Playlist id (pl_...) to copy into; must be empty.
